events.title: Quick Note for Players: Xbox Controllers & Steam Input Fix
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've spotted an issue where modern Xbox controllers can sometimes be misread or cause input conflicts in the game due to Steam Input virtualization.If your controller is registering as both P1 and P2, here is a quick 10-second fix to let the game read your hardware directly:Right-click the game in your Steam Library and select Properties.Go to the Controller tab on the left.Click the dropdown menu and select Disable Steam Input.That’s it!
